title: AI detector outcome metrics recording on retry exhaustion
answers: Why does posthog_insight_alerts_ai_detector_checks_total report more unavailable failures than scheduled checks?
Where should outcome metrics be recorded in retried Temporal alert activities?
Why does an AI detector alert check show both failure and success metric counts?
body:
Symptom: The AI detector unavailable metric (posthog_insight_alerts_ai_detector_checks_total{outcome="unavailable"}) overcounts failures by incrementing on every retry attempt rather than once per scheduled check.
Root cause: posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:evaluate_alert called record_ai_detector_check_outcome("unavailable") directly within the retryable activity attempt.
Fix pattern: Move outcome metric recording to the terminal failure activity (record_failed_evaluation), incrementing only when an errored check is recorded after retries are exhausted.
Constraints: Applies to terminal check outcome metrics in Temporal activities configured with retry policies; does not apply to per-attempt execution or latency metrics.
applies: Temporal alert evaluation activities and outcome metric tracking
